title: When Does Causality Help in Multivariate Time-Series Anomaly Detection?
abstract: arXiv:2611.15073v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Causality-aware scoring is common in multivariate time-series anomaly detection, yet the literature rarely states when it helps. Holding one causality-guided autoencoder (DeCauAE) fixed, we vary graph quality, anomaly type and protocol against ground truth. Graph quality fixes the payoff: on a twenty-variable DAG the gain over a graph-free autoencoder decays as the graph is corrupted. Anomaly type fixes the target: the structural factor lifts window F1 from 0.800 to 0.976 where anomalies break conditional structure, and its advantage vanishes below a break severity s 0.3. Protocol fixes the ranking: point-adjusted F1 lets a random score match the full model, while range-aware VUS separates the autoencoder family from the classical baselines. On real benchmarks the causal module pays only where density makes a system eligible and cross-subsample reproducibility selects entities inside it; enabling it everywhere costs 0.012 VUS-ROC. Th

translated_title: 因果性何时有助于多变量时间序列异常检测？
translated_abstract: 因果感知评分在多变量时间序列异常检测中很常见，但文献很少说明它何时有效。在保持一个因果引导的自编码器（DeCauAE）不变的情况下，我们相对于真实标准系统地改变图质量、异常类型和评估协议。图质量决定收益：在一个二十变量的有向无环图（DAG）上，相对于无图自编码器的增益随着图被破坏而衰减。异常类型决定目标：在异常破坏条件结构的场景中，结构因子将窗口F1从0.800提升到0.976，而当破坏严重度s低于0.3时其优势消失。评估协议决定排名：点调整F1会让随机评分也能匹配完整模型，而范围感知的VUS则能将自编码器家族与经典基线区分开来。在真实基准上，因果模块只有在系统密度符合条件且跨子样本可重复性能选出相应实体时才有回报；在所有地方启用它需付出0.012 VUS-ROC的代价。
tldr: 该研究通过固定因果引导自编码器并系统改变图质量、异常类型和评估协议，揭示了因果性在多变量时间序列异常检测中的三个有效条件：图质量决定收益大小、异常必须破坏条件结构（严重度≥0.3）才有效，且只有范围感知的VUS评估协议才能真实反映因果模块的性能优势。
en_tdlr: By holding a causality-guided autoencoder fixed and systematically varying graph quality, anomaly type, and evaluation protocol, this study identifies three conditions for causality to help in multivariate time-series anomaly detection: graph quality determines the payoff, anomalies must break conditional structure (severity ≥ 0.3) to be effective, and only range-aware VUS protocol truly separates causal models from baselines.
